analysis: The efferent fibers of the substantia nigra primarily project to the corpus striatum, which is part of the basal ganglia and plays a crucial role in the regulation of movement and coordination. Dopamine released from these fibers is essential for the modulation of motor control and is significantly involved in the pathophysiology of Parkinson's disease.
